units: <cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 15">Gen. R. s. 15</cite>, beg.; <cite ref="Midrash Tehillim 118:10">Midr. Till. to Ps. CIV, 16</cite> <he>ישבעון מַטָּעֲתָן</he> they (the cedars) shall enjoy their transplantation.
<cite ref="Bereishit Rabbah 30">Gen. R. s. 30</cite> <he>מַטָּעַת כרמים</he> plantation of vineyards.

<cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 2:3:3">Cant. R. to II, 3</cite> <he>כמטעת של כרם</he> (prob. <he>כמַטָּעוֹת</he> pl.) like the rows of plants in a vineyard. Midr. Sam. ch. XXVIII <he>מַטָּעָתָךְ מהיכן היא</he> whence is thy origin?

<cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Kilayim 4:6:4">Y. Kil. IV, end, 29ᶜ</cite> <he>יותר ממַטָּעָתוֹ</he> more than when it is cultivated. Midr. Sam. ch. XXV <he>שהיה רואה מטעת שלו נקצצת וכ׳</he> he saw his (Saul’s) plantation cut down (his descendants put to death, v.
<cite ref="II Samuel 21">II Sam. ch. XXI</cite>), and did not worry about it &c.; <cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 765:3">Yalk. Ps. 765</cite> <he>מעיל</he> (corr. acc.).
